title: Homological mirror symmetry for orbifold log Calabi-Yau surfaces
summary: We prove homological mirror symmetry for orbifold log Calabi-Yau surfaces at the large complex structure limit by constructing an abstract Lefschetz fibration associated to each pair $(\mathcal{X},\mathcal{D})$ with $\mathcal{X}$ a projective rational surface with isolated cyclic quotient orbifold points and $\mathcal{D}$ a stacky anticanonical divisor. We describe a Lefschetz stabilization procedure which, on the mirror, corresponds to the special McKay correspondence of Ishii and Ueda arXiv:1104.2381v2 [math.AG].
